description: An oil-style painting of an outdoor scene at a wooden table beside a brick building. A woman in a bonnet and dark hooded cloak faces a man in a tricorn hat who raises a hand toward her. A seated official in a tricorn hat holds papers beside a wooden ballot box and inkwell. Men in tricorns and long 18th-century coats crowd the porch and doorway. The painting fills the frame, with no visible text, border or wall.
